bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to children; providing funding to the Office of the Foster Youth Ombudsperson; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; OFFICE OF THE FOSTER YOUTH OMBUDSPERSON.

$240,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $240,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Office of the Foster Youth Ombudsperson for additional full-time employees to conduct outreach to foster youth.
additions: APPROPRIATION; OFFICE OF THE FOSTER YOUTH OMBUDSPERSON.
